rics.description: Chg Y/Y, GDP/GVA by Industry, Quarterly, Statistics Indonesia
rics.meaning: GDP/GVA by Industry, YoY — aggregate measure of value-added growth across industry sectors. Companion to GDP-by-expenditure release.
rics.how_to_use: Should track aIDCGDPYD/A closely. Differences reflect statistical-discrepancy items between expenditure and production approaches to GDP.

rics.description: GDP - ACCOMMODATION & FOOD SERVICE ACTIVITIES, Constant Prices, GDP/GVA by Industry, Quarterly, Statistics Indonesia
rics.meaning: GDP — Accommodation & Food Service Activities, Constant Prices — real hotels + restaurants GVA.
rics.how_to_use: Pre-COVID growth ~6% pa; collapsed in 2020-21; recovering. Tracks Bali tourism + middle-class restaurant spending.

rics.description: GDP - ACCOMMODATION & FOOD SERVICE ACTIVITIES, Current Prices, GDP/GVA by Industry, Quarterly, Statistics Indonesia
rics.meaning: GDP — Accommodation & Food Service Activities, Current Prices — hotels + restaurants nominal GVA. ~2.5% of GDP.
rics.how_to_use: Use constant-prices version (aIDVAEAHOTE/C) for volume cycle. Tracks tourism + domestic-restaurant demand.

rics.description: GDP - AGRICULTURE, FORESTRY & FISHING, Constant Prices, GDP/GVA by Industry, Quarterly, Statistics Indonesia
rics.meaning: GDP — Agriculture, Forestry & Fishing, constant prices. Includes palm oil, rubber, rice, fisheries. ~13% of GDP and ~28% of employment (high share given low productivity).
rics.how_to_use: Important for rural incomes and food prices. Palm oil exports (Indonesia is world's largest producer with Malaysia) drive value-added swings. Weather (El Niño, La Niña) is the dominant short-term variable. Pair with food CPI for the rural-urban transmission signal.

rics.description: GDP - AGRICULTURE, FORESTRY & FISHING, Current Prices, GDP/GVA by Industry, Quarterly, Statistics Indonesia
rics.meaning: GDP — Agriculture, Forestry & Fishing, Current Prices — nominal value-added in agriculture sector. Companion to aIDEAAG/C (constant prices).
rics.how_to_use: Use constant-prices version for cycle analysis; nominal version for nominal-GDP composition. Indonesia agri sector ~13% of nominal GDP, dominated by palm oil + rice + fisheries.

rics.description: GDP - ELECTRICITY & GAS SUPPLY, Constant Prices, GDP/GVA by Industry, Quarterly, Statistics Indonesia
rics.meaning: GDP — Electricity & Gas Supply, Constant Prices — real utilities GVA. ~1.2% of GDP.
rics.how_to_use: Stable growth ~5% pa tracks GDP. Electricity demand growth a development indicator.

rics.description: GDP - ELECTRICITY & GAS SUPPLY, Current Prices, GDP/GVA by Industry, Quarterly, Statistics Indonesia
rics.meaning: GDP — Electricity & Gas Supply, Current Prices — nominal utilities sector GVA. Includes PLN (state electricity utility) and gas distribution.
rics.how_to_use: Stable, low-cyclicality. Tracks electrification and economic growth.

rics.description: GDP - FINANCIAL & INSURANCE ACTIVITIES, Constant Prices, GDP/GVA by Industry, Quarterly, Statistics Indonesia
rics.meaning: GDP — Financial & Insurance Activities, constant prices — bank, insurance, asset-management sector value added. ~4% of GDP, smaller than DM economies (10-15%) but growing.
rics.how_to_use: Tracks financialization of the economy. Bank profitability cycles, insurance penetration (still very low at ~3% of GDP — major growth opportunity), and capital markets development drive growth. Indonesia's domestic capital markets remain underdeveloped vs peers — finance-sector GDP share is a structural-development metric.

rics.description: GDP - FINANCIAL & INSURANCE ACTIVITIES, Current Prices, GDP/GVA by Industry, Quarterly, Statistics Indonesia
rics.meaning: GDP — Financial & Insurance Activities, Current Prices — nominal finance-sector GVA.
rics.how_to_use: Use constant-prices version (aIDVAFONBS/C) for cycle. ~4% of GDP.

rics.description: GDP - OTHER SERVICES ACTIVITIES, Constant Prices, GDP/GVA by Industry, Quarterly, Statistics Indonesia
rics.meaning: GDP — Other Services Activities, Constant Prices — real residual services GVA. Small share (~2%).
rics.how_to_use: Captures non-categorized services. Use category-specific GVA series for sector cycle analysis.

rics.description: GDP - OTHER SERVICES ACTIVITIES, Current Prices, GDP/GVA by Industry, Quarterly, Statistics Indonesia
rics.meaning: GDP — Other Services Activities, Current Prices — nominal residual services GVA. Includes personal services, household services, NGO activities.
rics.how_to_use: Use constant-prices version (aIDVADSS/C) for volume cycle. Captures services not classified in main sectors. Small share of GDP (~2%).

rics.description: GDP - TRANSPORTATION & STORAGE, Constant Prices, GDP/GVA by Industry, Quarterly, Statistics Indonesia
rics.meaning: GDP — Transportation & Storage, constant prices. Includes road, rail, air, sea transport plus warehousing. ~5% of GDP. Vital for an archipelagic economy.
rics.how_to_use: Logistics costs are a long-running competitiveness drag — Indonesia logistics-cost-to-GDP runs ~24% (vs ~14% for ASEAN-5 peers). Toll-road network expansion and Pelabuhan Indonesia (port operator) mergers aim to reduce this. Sector growth correlates with manufacturing and trade volumes.

rics.description: GDP - TRANSPORTATION & STORAGE, Current Prices, GDP/GVA by Industry, Quarterly, Statistics Indonesia
rics.meaning: GDP — Transportation & Storage, Current Prices — nominal transport-and-storage GVA.
rics.how_to_use: Use constant-prices version (aIDVAEATRAC/C). ~5% of GDP. Critical for archipelagic economy.

rics.description: NPI SERVING HOUSEHOLD CONSUMPTION EXPENDITURE, Current Prices, GDP/GVA by Industry, Quarterly, Statistics Indonesia
rics.meaning: NPI Serving Household Consumption Expenditure, Current Prices — final consumption expenditure of non-profit institutions serving households (NPISH). Small GDP component (~1%).
rics.how_to_use: Niche. Niches captures religious organizations, charities, foundations. Tracks NGO and faith-organization activity.

rics.description: Value Added, Economic Activity, Construction, Constant Prices, GDP/GVA by Industry, Quarterly, Statistics Indonesia
rics.meaning: Value Added: Construction, constant prices — construction sector GDP. Includes infrastructure (roads, ports, railways), residential, and commercial real estate construction. ~11% of GDP.
rics.how_to_use: Highly cyclical with infrastructure spending and BI rates. Surged during Jokowi's 2014-2024 infrastructure push (toll roads, MRT, dams, airports). Deceleration since 2024 reflects rate hikes and fiscal consolidation. Track alongside cement consumption and steel demand.

rics.description: Value Added, Economic Activity, Construction, Current Prices, GDP/GVA by Industry, Quarterly, Statistics Indonesia
rics.meaning: Value Added: Construction, Current Prices — nominal construction sector GVA.
rics.how_to_use: Use constant-prices version (aIDVADCONS/C) for volume cycle. ~11% of nominal GDP.

rics.description: Value Added, Economic Activity, Manufacturing industry, Constant Prices, GDP/GVA by Industry, Quarterly, Statistics Indonesia
rics.meaning: Value Added: Manufacturing Industry, constant prices — the manufacturing sector's contribution to GDP at constant prices. Indonesia's largest single industry sector at ~18-20% of GDP.
rics.how_to_use: Indonesia targets manufacturing as a growth driver (Making Indonesia 4.0 program). Key sub-sectors: food & beverage (largest), chemicals, transportation equipment, base metals (nickel processing post-2020 export bans). Track quarterly growth — sustained sub-3% indicates deindustrialization concerns.

rics.description: Value Added, Economic Activity, Manufacturing industry, Current Prices, GDP/GVA by Industry, Quarterly, Statistics Indonesia
rics.meaning: Value Added: Manufacturing Industry, Current Prices — nominal manufacturing GVA.
rics.how_to_use: Use constant-prices version (aIDVADGM/C) for cycle. Manufacturing is Indonesia's largest single sector at ~18-20% of nominal GDP.

rics.description: Value Added, Economic Activity, Mining and quarrying, Constant Prices, GDP/GVA by Industry, Quarterly, Statistics Indonesia
rics.meaning: Value Added: Mining and Quarrying, constant prices — the mining/extractive sector's contribution to GDP. Includes coal, oil/gas, nickel, copper, gold, tin extraction. ~10-12% of GDP, highly cyclical with commodity prices.
rics.how_to_use: Most volatile GDP component. Coal (Indonesia is world's largest thermal coal exporter) and oil/gas dominate. Surged 2021-22 with commodity boom; decelerated 2023+ on lower coal/nickel prices. Watch global commodity prices for the leading signal.

rics.description: Value Added, Economic Activity, Mining and quarrying, Current Prices, GDP/GVA by Industry, Quarterly, Statistics Indonesia
rics.meaning: Value Added: Mining and Quarrying, Current Prices — nominal mining sector GVA.
rics.how_to_use: Highly volatile with commodity prices. Use constant-prices version (aIDVADMIN/C) for volume cycle.
